units: <cite ref="Eruvin 55a:10">Erub. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>עיר העשויה כק׳</he> a town built in the shape of a bow; <cite ref="Eruvin 55a:10">ib.</cite> <he>עשויה כמין ק׳</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 59a:12">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>הרואה את הק׳ בענן</he> he who sees a rainbow in the clouds.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 35">Gen. R. s. 35</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְשָתוֹת</he>. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 22:3">Is. XXII, 3</cite>) <he>שהיו מתירין גידי קַשְׁתּוֹתָם וכ׳</he> they loosened the strings of their bows and tied them with them; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 289">Yalk. Is. 289</cite>.
Sifré Deut. 18 עקרבים כק׳ scorpions as large as bows; Yalk. ib. 803; a. e.—Trnsf. membrum virile, potentia virilis.
<cite ref="Sotah 36b:14">Sot. 36ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 2:5:5">Y. Hor. II, 46ᵈ</cite>; a. e.
